Figure 2: The framework of drift-aware tokenizer adaptation in DACT. DACT introduces CDIM to learn drift patterns and update-policy prototypes, which predicts a drift confidence score to guide the differentiated training strategy. Additionally, a global code-assignment stability constraint is applied to all items.
